name: tgclone
description: A full-featured, real-time messaging application built with modern web technologies. Experience seamless communication with a Telegram-inspired interface.
author: Azizbek Tilavov <azizbektilavov882@gmail.com>

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build-and-start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.render-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm install
